text:
kevin: Heads-up — hotpatch PR https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/infra/pulls/7890 needs 2x LGTM before the 30m cutoff. It rolls forward tokenizer-lib to v1.3 (blocking dep for runtime). Staging tests are failing intermittently. Can someone take a quick look? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

akash: on it, starting a local run now. tag me if you need a deeper review. :eyes:

olivia: @oncall just FYI, this touches tokenizer native bindings — possible preflight infra attention.

maria: quick Q — what's the failure pattern in staging? flaky perf or deterministic regression?

kevin: test failures look deterministic for a subset of tokenization asserts (split offsets differ). Logs below:
```
FAIL tests/test_tokenizer_integration.py::test_batch_alignment
E AssertionError: arrays differ
E Mismatched elements: 3 / 12 (25%)
E Max absolute difference: 2
E Max relative difference: 0.5
E  x: array([12, 34, 56, 78])
E  y: array([12, 34, 55, 78])
```

jon: that sounds like a changeset in token boundary logic. Is v1.3 preserving the old behavior behind a flag?

kevin: no flag; upstream fixed a long-standing trimming bug but it changes offsets. We need the runtime to handle both behaviors. Two options: (1) update runtime tests and code to accept new offsets (preferred long-term), or (2) pin tokenizer to v1.2 for this hotfix and schedule a behavior-preserving migration. Given cutoff, option 2 is safer.

olivia: +1 for pinning for hotfix. Can we do pin + canary? e.g., deploy with v1.2 to 95% and reserve 5% for internal canary that uses v1.3 after a follow-up change?

akash: I can prep a rollback/pin PR quickly. ETA ~ 18m.

kevin: that would be perfect. We need two LGTM on the pin PR to merge before cutoff. I'll link it once ready.

deploy-bot: Build 2891 for PR #7890 — CI: failing (unit) — see https://ci.redwood.ai/build/2891/logs

maria: tagging infra @olivia — if we pin, can you validate the packaging and release script still behaves (we had one edge case with wheel tags last month)?

olivia: will validate packaging when the pin PR is up. If tests pass in staging after pin, we can fast-track to release.

jon: if anyone lands the pin PR, ping me for quick review — I can do a rapid LGTM if it's just dependency change.

akash: PR created: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/infra/pulls/7893 — pins tokenizer-lib to v1.2 and adds a test guard. Short description in PR body.

kevin: linking PRs: original rollforward is 7890, pin PR is 7893. We need two approvers for 7893 before cutoff. Can any of you spare a quick review? :pray:

maria: reviewing now. If it's pure pin + changelog, should be quick.

jon: on it, reviewing diff.

maria: LGTM — looks like just package.json and lockfile change + one test guard.

jon: LGTM as well.

kevin: awesome — thanks both. akash please merge when CI green.

akash: merging now. CI jobs queued.

deploy-bot: PR 7893 merged by akash at 2938475790. CI: all green. Deploy pipeline triggered: https://ci.redwood.ai/deploy/512

kevin: rolling to prod short-canary 5% then full if healthy. Thanks everyone :tada:

olivia: will monitor packaging and logs. If we see token offset anomalies post-cutover we revert and schedule a proper runtime migration.

maria: logged follow-up ticket to reintroduce v1.3 compatibility and add migration tests: https://issues.redwood.ai/RED-4120

kevin: closing the loop — cutover complete, hotfix shipped within cutoff. Great coordination. :heart:
